production-provider-abuse-acceptance.note: The zero-write authenticated rivalry enumeration-denial probe avoided fabricating a third account or revoked device and returned the exact qualifying production permission denial with stable authentication and unchanged browser storage. stage5a-candidate-emulator-proof.note: The exact GitHub Actions emulator job first exposed authority-read ordering and fixture-snapshot mismatches, then provider logs exposed expression-budget exhaustion on forged late-failing updates. Automated review subsequently found that entitled direct reads still lacked provider-verifiable current-device identity. The corrected client and candidate Rules now require an active device_id token claim, bind writes to it and prove missing, unknown, revoked and mismatched credentials fail closed.

stage5b-device-credential-foundation-pro.note: Contract, Chromium and Auth-plus-Firestore emulator proof forced the credential boundary from a user-wide mutable custom-claim concept to non-extractable P-256 proof of possession with per-sign-in device_id/device_key_sha256 claims. Codex review then caught that candidate Rules had not bound the key/version; direct Rules fixtures now close that gap. The owner's later permanent no-billing decision preserves Stage 5B as dormant research while selecting standard Google Auth plus exact-path Firestore Rules on Spark as the production critical path.
